instructions:
1. Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with chest and hips on the pad.
2. Hold an EZ barbell with palms facing down, hands shoulder-width apart, bar near your shoulders.
3. Press the bar forward and slightly up until your arms are fully extended.
4. Pause briefly with arms straight.
5. Lower the bar back to your shoulders with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest and hips pressed to the pad throughout.
2. Move slowly to keep tension on the rear delts and upper back.
3. Exhale as you press, inhale as you lower.
4. Do not swing or use momentum.
name: EZ Barbell Anti Gravity Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ barbell with a close grip and palms facing up.
2. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
4. Lower the bar with control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
2. Do not swing your torso to lift the bar.
3. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
4. Control the descent for full muscle tension.
name: EZ Barbell Close grip Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding an EZ barbell at shoulder-width with palms facing up.
2. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders by bending your elbows.
3. Squeeze your biceps at the top.
4. Lower the bar with control until your arms are fully extended.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
2. Do not swing or use momentum.
3. Exhale as you curl up, inhale as you lower.
4. Control the lowering phase.
name: EZ Barbell Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, arms at your sides.
2. Rapidly lift your feet up and down on the spot, staying on the balls of your feet.
3. Keep your core tight and knees soft to stay light.
4. Use your arms naturally for balance.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stay on the forefeet for quick, light steps.
2. Keep a steady, fast turnover.
3. Hold a slight knee bend the whole time.
4. Breathe steadily throughout.
name: Fast feet

instructions:
1. Stand with feet together, barbell resting across your upper back with an overhand grip.
2. Bend your knees and hips to lower into a squat, keeping knees tracking over your toes.
3. Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
4. Push through your heels to stand back up, extending knees and hips.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your feet together for the full movement.
2. Keep your chest up and spine neutral.
3. Do not let your knees cave inward.
4. Brace your core before each descent.
name: Feet together barbell squats
